summary: Join our training course to learn about legal structures for real estate investment. Gain valuable insights and strategies to elevate your investment game.
lede: Legal structures for real estate investment define how ownership, control, and liability are arranged. For investment managers, developers, finance teams, and other property professionals, the course supports choosing and overseeing investment structures by comparing ownership vehicles, allocating rights and responsibilities, and assessing financing, governance, and exit arrangements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage with or are affected by legal structures in real estate investment.
audience: Real estate investment managers and portfolio managers
Private investors, family office representatives, and high
modules: Foundations of Legal Structures in Real Estate
Property Rights, Land Tenure, and Title
Ownership Vehicles: Individual, Partnership, and Company Structures
Trusts, Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs), and Holding Companies
Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and Fund Structures
Tax Considerations in Real Estate Legal Structures
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of real estate investment principles and some experience in real estate transactions. Familiarity with financial and legal concepts will be beneficial but is not mandatory.
